title: Map the three proven switch_pt forms to the accepted Engine child

replaces_attempt.reason: The Claude fallback was session-quota limited. The Qwen prepared adapter is now corrected to consume SSE and expose exact parser probe output; this is the same semantic contract on the repaired compatible adapter.

evidence.fact: The pinned ground truth contains 17 sole switch_pt misses and exactly self, bare target creature, and each creature positive forms, with target player as an adjacent negative.
The accepted Engine child consumes self as no target, target creature as a bare creature target, and each creature as value.target=each.
map_atom is the sole implementation seam; exact parser probes are supplied by the Map packet so the no-tools worker need not guess nested obj shapes.

required_behavior: For activated or triggered self forms, map to ('switch_pt', {}, None). Do not map a targetless spell source.
For a bare target creature form, map to ('switch_pt', {}, {'filter': 'creature'}).
For each creature, map to ('switch_pt', {'target': 'each'}, None).
Target player, qualified targets, and 'each creature on the battlefield' remain unmapped.
Add focused direct map_atom tests for the three positives and target-player negative.
gates: git status --porcelain adds or changes only scripts/paragraph/reparse.py and scripts/paragraph/test_switch_pt.py
python3 /opt/development/magic-ops/scripts/factory-ng-targeted-demand.py verb_unmapped:switch_pt reports zero members after the candidate Map patch

execution.selection_reason: The small Map contract is a Qwen-direct fit. Adapter v1.0.1 changes only transport/telemetry (SSE plus include_usage) and packet grounding (exact parser probes), not model thinking or task scope.

on_failure: Record an immutable receipt. Do not change parsing, Engine code, or corpus data; any broader grammar is a separate ticket.
